data.name: Tales Of Glory 4 : Ragnarok
data.detailed_description:
Before the sagas. Before the heroes. Before the realm of Kvir stood united.

The northern tribes lived scattered across frozen valleys and harsh frontiers, struggling under the tightening grip of the Eastbornians — foreign rulers who claim the land, the harvest, and the lives of its people.

But something stirs beneath the snow. Whispers travel through forests and fjords — of shadows moving where no man walks, of ancient powers waking, of a storm gathering beyond the horizon.

In this prequel to Tales of Glory, you step into the boots of a young warrior rising from obscurity. Your task is not conquest — it is unity. Rally the broken tribes, defend the frontier, and forge the first spark of what will one day become the kingdom of Kvir.

The world is changing. And when the storm finally breaks, nothing will be the same.

Unite the tribes. Defy the Eastbornians. Shape the dawn of Kvir.

• VR Full‑Physics Combat

Fight with weight, impact, and physicality. Every swing, block, grab, and throw is driven by your own movement — no canned animations, no shortcuts.

• Lead a Viking Warband

Command squads of Nordic warriors in large‑scale battles. Issue orders, break enemy lines, and turn desperate fights into legendary victories.

• Explore Dangerous Dungeons

Descend into ancient ruins, forgotten tunnels, and shadowed depths hiding relics, secrets, and things best left undisturbed.

• Multiple Battlefields & Game Modes

Fight across snowy forests, burning villages, mountain passes, and fortified camps — with varied modes that keep combat fresh and replayable.

• A Full Campaign in the Spirit of TOG1

Experience a story‑driven campaign charting the rise of Kvir, blending open‑field warfare, village defense, dungeon exploration, and large‑scale assaults.

• Fully Moddable

Customize, expand, and reshape the game with full modding support — from weapons and maps to entirely new experiences crafted by the community.

data.short_description: Before Kvir rose, its tribes lived under Eastbornian rule. As shadows stir beneath the snow, you must unite the North and spark the dawn of a realm destined for glory. The storm is coming — and nothing will be the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX1070
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR limited to 2 buttons controllers (see notes)
  • Additional Notes: Needs 2 buttons VR controllers (Valve Index / Oculus Touch controllers or similar) - Not compatible with Vive Wands - Not Compatible with WMR devices
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 8-16 Core 4GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR limited to 2 buttons controllers (see notes)
  • Additional Notes: Needs 2 buttons VR controllers (Valve Index / Oculus Touch controllers or similar) - Not compatible with Vive Wands - Not Compatible with WMR devices

content_descriptors.notes: Realistic medieval battles so expect a lot of blood
